title: Earth and Education
teaser: A cataclysmic earthquake destroys eastern Sicily, killing 60,000 — then spawns a Baroque architectural miracle. Locke publishes his treatise on education, arguing children arrive as blank slates. Halley invents actuarial science. Congreve transforms English comedy. The Ladies' Mercury becomes the first women's magazine. Madame de La Fayette, who invented the psychological novel, dies in Paris. A year of destruction and reinvention — the old world crumbling, new ideas rising.
